intro: If Phanom Rung and Prasat Muang Tam are the headline of your Buriram trip, staying in Buriram city may be farther than you expect — Phanomrungpuri Hotel in Nang Rong District is the name that keeps coming up in reviews from Khmer-temple travelers. A 3-star boutique with 66 rooms styled in a Khmer-Isan blend with rattan furniture, it sits about 30 km from Phanom Rung — an easy drive. Rooms start from approx ฿850/night, with a score of 8.8 and ranked #1 in Nang Rong on TripAdvisor.

body.html: The selling point of Phanomrungpuri is its location in Nang Rong District, on Nang Rong-Lamplaimat Road. It sits about 1 km from Nang Rong town and roughly 25-30 km from both Phanom Rung and Prasat Muang Tam — under half an hour by car. For anyone planning an early start to catch the sunrise aligning through the doorways of Phanom Rung, or to tour the Khmer temple cluster in a single day, staying here trims a lot of driving compared with basing yourself in Buriram city.

The hotel leans into a Khmer aesthetic mixed with lower-northeastern Isan art — sandstone-temple motifs, rattan furniture and earthy tones. There are 66 rooms, from Superior King/Twin (27 sqm) up to Deluxe and Family (32 sqm), and larger options like the Duplex Family and Grand Duplex Suite (42-50 sqm). Every room has air-con, TV, fridge, minibar and free Wi-Fi. What guests praise most is that the rooms are spacious, the beds comfortable, and the grounds clean and leafy.
"Clean rooms, comfy beds, friendly English-speaking staff, and Phanom Rung is a short drive away — perfect for a temple trip."

Common areas include an outdoor pool, a fitness room, the Barai restaurant (indoor and outdoor seating), the 212Bar, a playground and Thai massage. Bike rental and airport transfers are available too. Breakfast is a buffet that most guests describe as solid for an out-of-town hotel at this price — not hugely varied but filling and decent in quality. The shaded, quiet grounds earn consistent praise.

Worth knowing before you book: several honest reviews mention fairly thin walls and noise carrying from neighboring rooms on some nights. The pool is on the small side, and power outlets in the rooms are limited — pack a power strip if you carry several devices. The hotel also suits self-drivers or car renters better, as it's out of town and public transport is not as easy to hail here as in the city.

The other trade-off to weigh: if your main goal is football at Chang Arena or racing at the Chang International Circuit, this hotel is about 50 km from Buriram city, so you'll need to budget driving time on event days. But if your focus is Phanom Rung, Prasat Muang Tam and the Nang Rong countryside, this location is more convenient than staying downtown.

Overall, it's a hotel that does the Phanom Rung-base job well at an easy price — spacious, clean rooms, leafy grounds, friendly staff, and far closer to the Khmer temples than Buriram city. The 8.8 score and #1-in-Nang-Rong ranking reflect a guest base that mostly leaves happy. If you can live with sound through the walls and a modest pool, it's good value for travelers here for temples and history.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Phanomrungpuri Hotel, Nang Rong

faq.q: Where is Phanomrungpuri Hotel and how far is Phanom Rung?
faq.a: It's at 212 Nang Rong-Lamplaimat Road, Nang Rong District, Buriram, about 1 km from Nang Rong town. Phanom Rung and Prasat Muang Tam are roughly 25-30 km away, around a 30-minute drive. Buriram city is about 50 km away.

faq.q: What are the room types and starting price at Phanomrungpuri Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx ฿850/night for a Superior. Options run from Superior King/Twin (27 sqm), Deluxe and Family (32 sqm), up to Duplex Family and Grand Duplex Suite (42-50 sqm). Prices vary by date, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is it a good base for visiting Phanom Rung?
faq.a: Yes, very much so. It's in Nang Rong District, closer to the Khmer temple cluster than Buriram city. Phanom Rung is about a 30-minute drive — ideal for an early start to catch the sunrise through the temple doorways or to tour Prasat Muang Tam the same day.

faq.q: Is it suitable for visiting Chang Arena?
faq.a: Not ideal if matches are your focus. The hotel is in Nang Rong District, about 50 km from Chang Arena and Buriram city, a long drive on event days. For football or racing, a hotel near the arena is more convenient — but for temple touring, this is the better spot.

faq.q: Anything to watch out for before booking?
faq.a: Honest reviews note fairly thin walls and noise from neighboring rooms on some nights, a small pool, and limited power outlets in the rooms. Ask for a corner or upper-floor room, and pack earplugs and a power strip.

There's free parking, handy for self-drive temple touring. On-site facilities include an outdoor pool, fitness room, Barai restaurant, 212Bar, a playground, Thai massage, plus bike rental and transfers. Wi-Fi is free in all rooms.
